entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments: ¶Wisdom is building her house, but the foolish woman is pulling it down with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:2
segments: ¶He who goes on his way in righteousness has before him the fear of the Lord; but he whose ways are twisted gives him no honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: ¶In the mouth of the foolish man is a rod for his back, but the lips of the wise will keep them safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: ¶Where there are no oxen, their food-place is clean; but much increase comes through the strength of the ox.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:5
segments: ¶A true witness does not say what is false, but a false witness is breathing out deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: ¶The hater of authority, searching for wisdom, does not get it; but knowledge comes readily to the open-minded man.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:7
segments: ¶Go away from the foolish man, for you will not see the lips of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: ¶The wisdom of the man of good sense makes his way clear; but the unwise behaviour of the foolish is deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: ¶In the tents of those hating authority there is error, but in the house of the upright man there is grace.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: ¶No one has knowledge of a man's grief but himself; and a strange person has no part in his joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:11
segments: ¶The house of the sinner will be overturned, but the tent of the upright man will do well.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: ¶There is a way which seems straight before a man, but its end is the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: ¶Even while laughing the heart may be sad; and after joy comes sorrow.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: ¶He whose heart is turned away will have the reward of his ways in full measure; but a good man will have the reward of his doings.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: ¶The simple man has faith in every word, but the man of good sense gives thought to his footsteps.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: ¶The wise man, fearing, keeps himself from evil; but the foolish man goes on in his pride, with no thought of danger.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: ¶He who is quickly angry will do what is foolish, but the man of good sense will have quiet.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: ¶Foolish behaviour is the heritage of the simple, but men of good sense are crowned with knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: ¶The knees of the evil are bent before the good; and sinners go down in the dust at the doors of the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: ¶The poor man is hated even by his neighbour, but the man of wealth has numbers of friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: ¶He who has no respect for his neighbour is a sinner, but he who has pity for the poor is happy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:22
segments: ¶Will not the designers of evil come into error? But mercy and good faith are for the designers of good.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: ¶In all hard work there is profit, but talk only makes a man poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: ¶Their wisdom is a crown to the wise, but their foolish behaviour is round the head of the unwise.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: ¶A true witness is the saviour of lives; but he who says false things is a cause of deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:26
segments: ¶For him in whose heart is the fear of the Lord there is strong hope: and his children will have a safe place.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, by which one may be turned from the nets of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:28
segments: ¶A king's glory is in the number of his people: and for need of people a ruler may come to destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: ¶He who is slow to be angry has great good sense; but he whose spirit is over-quick gives support to what is foolish.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: ¶A quiet mind is the life of the body, but envy is a disease in the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: ¶He who is hard on the poor puts shame on his Maker; but he who has mercy on those who are in need gives him honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: ¶The sinner is overturned in his evil-doing, but the upright man has hope in his righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: ¶Wisdom has her resting-place in the mind of the wise, but she is not seen among the foolish.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:34
segments: ¶By righteousness a nation is lifted up, but sin is a cause of shame to the peoples.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: ¶The king has pleasure in a servant who does wisely, but his wrath is against him who is a cause of shame.
